key_findings: Human Fabry endothelial cells show dysregulated HIF1a/HIF2, reduced VEGFA and impaired tube formation rescued by ALK5/TGFβ inhibitor SB-431542.
Old GLA KO mouse DRG shows higher nuclear HIF1a, CA9 upregulation and reduced vascularization, supporting hypoxia in Fabry pain.
